keys.swarm.aura_iron_fists_desc: Two spectral fists float at your shoulders and punch one-two: each rockets at the nearest monster, ploughs through the line, knocks back and flies home.
keys.swarm.aura_iron_fists_up: Harder punches; from level 5 both fists punch together.
keys.swarm.aura_iron_fists_ten: Titan's Hands: two giant stone hands clap together in front of you, crushing and stunning all between.
keys.swarm.aura_cleaver_rain_desc: Cleavers are hurled up in an arc and come crashing down in a line ahead of you.
keys.swarm.aura_cleaver_rain_ten: Butcher's Storm: cleavers whirl down all round you.
